ca998e3c68a913.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Global Tourism Award 2025 received by the Andhra Pradesh Tourism Department?
o: It was instituted by the Global News Network.
It was received by tourism consultant Nishitha Goyal on behalf of the department.
It was instituted by the Andhra Pradesh Tourism Department.
It was presented at a ceremony in New Delhi.
ca998e3c68a913.x: The award was instituted by the Global News Network, not by the AP Tourism Department; Nishitha Goyal received it at the New Delhi ceremony.

ca36e3af25c16d.s: Which of the following pairs (Swachha Andhra Awards 2025) is correctly matched?
o: Best Swachha NGO – SS Palm Tree Villas Association
Swachha Municipality (1–3 lakh population) – Mana Ooru, Mana Gudi, Mana Bhadyatha
ca36e3af25c16d.x: Anantapur won Best Swachha District 2025; Tadipatri won the municipality category, SS Palm Tree Villas Association won Swachha Colonies and Mana Ooru, Mana Gudi, Mana Bhadyatha won Best Swachha NGO.

ca8812b7d984e2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about MEPMA's award at the Swachha Andhra Awards 2025?
o: It won the Best Social Media Management category.
The award was received by N. Tej Bharath, MEPMA Mission Director.
It was chosen from among 19 departments.
ca8812b7d984e2.x: MEPMA won the Best Social Media Management award among 19 departments, not 19 municipalities.

ca87904fcd3a7e.s: Which historian discovered the 17th-century Telugu inscription in Prakasam district and referred it to the ASI, Mysuru?
ca87904fcd3a7e.x: Jyothi Chandramouli, a retired headmaster from Addanki, discovered the inscription and referred it to the Archaeological Survey of India, Mysuru.

ca1451005495c4.s: The new Andhra Pradesh tourism policy, linked to the state's Global Tourism Award 2025, includes which model?
ca1451005495c4.x: The new tourism policy includes a Public-Private Partnership model, a roadmap for investors and an emphasis on eco-friendly, sustainable development.

ca04572903697a.s: In September 2025, Andhra Pradesh received the Central Silk Board's Best State Award under which programme?
ca04572903697a.x: AP received the Best State Award under Mera Resham – Mera Abhiman at the Central Silk Board's 76th Foundation Day in Bengaluru on 20 September 2025.

cad3dc5523d57f.s: M. Thirumala Sridevi, the only Andhra Pradesh teacher to receive the National Best Teacher Award 2025, heads a school at:
cad3dc5523d57f.x: Madabathula Thirumala Sridevi is headmistress of Pandit Nehru Municipal High School, Bheemili; she was the only AP teacher among the 45 selected nationally.

caf9bfde040526.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the SKOCH Awards 2025 won by the Andhra Pradesh Revenue Department?
o: The awards are given by the Government of India.
The awards are given by the SKOCH Group.
The SKOCH Group is an independent think tank.
The Revenue Department won for the Online Court Management System and Re-Survey 2.0.
caf9bfde040526.x: The SKOCH Awards are given by the SKOCH Group, an independent think tank, not by the Government of India.

caca740b064be6.s: Who presented the National Best Teacher Award 2025 to M. Thirumala Sridevi on 5 September 2025?
caca740b064be6.x: President Droupadi Murmu presented the award on 5 September 2025, observed as Teachers' Day.

cad72a0834019f.s: Students of headmistress M. Thirumala Sridevi's school in Bheemili built which device?
cad72a0834019f.x: The students built a cloudburst indicator; the school's other initiatives included Chromebook teaching, art-integrated learning and 100% anaemia-free status.

cad7d20e7dee9d.s: The mango covers introduced in Chittoor district to protect the fruit were made of:
cad7d20e7dee9d.x: The covers were made of biodegradable iron-wire mesh and placed over each mango.

cacb233333636c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Nandamuri Balakrishna?
o: He made his debut as a child artist in 1974.
He is a TDP MLA from Hindupur.
His child-artist debut film was Mangammagari Manavadu.
He is Chairman of Basavatarakam Indo American Cancer Hospital & Research Institute.
cacb233333636c.x: His child-artist debut was in 1974 in Tatamma Kala; Mangammagari Manavadu came later in his film career.

cabbf4cb3c2a76.s: The Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister has set a target to cut chemical fertiliser use next year by:
cabbf4cb3c2a76.x: The target is to cut chemical fertiliser use by 4 lakh tonnes next year.

caed999062f879.s: Which of the following pairs of continent and highest peak is correctly matched?
caed999062f879.x: Vinson Massif (4,892 m) is Antarctica's highest peak; Kilimanjaro is in Africa and Elbrus in Europe.

ca11fcb4798eb2.s:
Consider the following statements about the Yogandhra campaign:
1. It was conducted only for senior citizens.
2. It covered only urban areas.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca11fcb4798eb2.x: Both are wrong: Yogandhra was a statewide campaign covering rural and urban areas and all sections of people.

ca37c4355a61d1.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The English Channel lies between Tamil Nadu and Sri Lanka.
2. The Palk Strait links the Bay of Bengal and the Gulf of Mannar.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca37c4355a61d1.x: The English Channel lies between England and France; the Palk Strait links the Bay of Bengal and the Gulf of Mannar.

ca1fca195cf895.s: Which former DRDO Chairman assumed charge as Advisor for Aerospace and Defence to the Andhra Pradesh government in May 2025?
ca1fca195cf895.x: Dr G Satish Reddy, former DRDO Chairman, assumed charge as Advisor for Aerospace and Defence to the AP government.

ca8fe70abc8ef0.s: What was the stated objective of appointing Dr G Satish Reddy as Advisor for Aerospace and Defence to the AP government?
o: To shift the DRDO headquarters to Andhra Pradesh
To make Andhra Pradesh a global hub for defence industries and create jobs
To build a new launch pad at Sriharikota
To set up a defence university in Amaravati
ca8fe70abc8ef0.x: The objective was to make Andhra Pradesh a global hub for defence industries and generate jobs.

ca7e3d526a9dc4.s: Which of the following is associated with DRDO?
o: PSLV, GSLV and SSLV launch vehicles
Agni, Prithvi, Akash and Nag missiles, and Mission Shakti
ca7e3d526a9dc4.x: DRDO's contributions include the Agni, Prithvi, Akash and Nag missiles, and it led Mission Shakti; the other options belong to ISRO.

ca2f44f588ee25.s:
Consider the following statements about the Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota:
1. It was named after Dr Satish Dhawan in 2002.
2. It has only one operational launch pad.
3. Its proximity to the equator makes launches fuel-efficient.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca2f44f588ee25.x: The Centre was named after Dr Satish Dhawan in 2002 and benefits from proximity to the equator, but it has two operational launch pads, not one.

ca52c741119d03.s: Which of the following pairs (AP products at the 44th India International Trade Fair 2025) is correctly matched?
ca52c741119d03.x: Krishna & Guntur showcased pickles and condiments, Nellore crochet lace and Kadapa handicrafts and mineral-based products.

ca38414272b5e3.s:
Consider the following statements about the Centre of Excellence for Studies in Classical Telugu (CESCT):
1. It was launched in Mysuru in 2019.
2. It was shifted to Nellore in 2018 at the instance of M. Venkaiah Naidu.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca38414272b5e3.x: Both are wrong: CESCT was launched in Mysuru in 2018 and shifted to Nellore in 2019 at the instance of then Vice-President M. Venkaiah Naidu.

ca2cda1362f19a.s: The distinctive red colour of Erra Matti Dibbalu is due to:
ca2cda1362f19a.x: The red colour comes from ferrous minerals reacting with moisture; the dunes themselves formed during the Last Glacial Maximum.

ca0015fa4424c8.s: The legal conclave 'Sri Ramayana Sankharavam' of the Valmiki Research Centre (National Sanskrit University) was held on 20 September at:
ca0015fa4424c8.x: It was held on 20 September at the Vizianagaram campus, on ethical and constitutional lessons from the Valmiki Ramayana.

cac9e0d9460b44.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Ugadi is the Telugu and Kannada New Year and falls on the first day of Chaitra.
2. The Samvatsara cycle associated with Ugadi consists of 60 years.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac9e0d9460b44.x: Both are correct: Ugadi marks the Telugu and Kannada New Year on Chaitra's first day, and the Samvatsara cycle has 60 years.

caef1cb211c2e8.s: Which publication was released during the Ugadi Puraskaralu 2025 programme?
caef1cb211c2e8.x: The Vishwavasu Nama Samvatsara Panchangam of TTD was released during Ugadi Puraskaralu 2025.

ca115019c023fe.s: Which of the following pairs related to New Year observances is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Bitter taste in Ugadi Pachadi – Neem flowers
ca115019c023fe.x: Puthandu is Tamil Nadu's New Year; Karnataka celebrates Ugadi.

ca7527a3eb01a8.s: Meritorious sportspersons under the 3% horizontal reservation in AP direct recruitment are selected:
o: Without a written examination, from a State Level Committee merit list via APPSC and other boards
Through a written examination conducted by the Sports Authority of Andhra Pradesh
Through a written examination conducted only by APPSC
Through an interview conducted by district collectors
ca7527a3eb01a8.x: Selection is made without a written examination, on the merit list prepared by the State Level Committee through APPSC and other boards.

cae7aa0bb82b0a.s:
Consider the following statements about GST 2.0:
1. The GST rate on cement was reduced from 28% to 12%.
2. The GST rate on marble, granite and bricks was reduced from 12% to 5%.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cae7aa0bb82b0a.x: Cement moved from 28% to 18%, not 12%; marble, granite and bricks moved from 12% to 5%.

ca32488e10a55c.s: Who led Andhra Pradesh's statewide 'Super GST – Super Savings' campaign on the benefits of GST 2.0?
ca32488e10a55c.x: The campaign was led by Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu.

cae63f35d0d2d4.s:
Consider the following statements about AP's 'Super GST – Super Savings' campaign:
1. It included tractor rallies and bike rallies.
2. It included MSME fairs and essay and painting contests.
3. Its finale was shopping festivals and cultural programmes at district headquarters around Diwali.
Which of the above statements are correct?
cae63f35d0d2d4.x: The campaign included tractor and bike rallies, MSME fairs, essay and painting contests and drives in salons and gyms, with shopping festivals and cultural programmes as the Diwali finale.

ca9af6796ca606.s: Which of the following pairs (minister – portfolio, AP social-media Group of Ministers) is correctly matched?
o: Y. Satya Kumar Yadav – Civil Supplies
ca9af6796ca606.x: Nara Lokesh holds IT and HRD; Satya Kumar Yadav holds Medical and Health, Nadendla Manohar Civil Supplies and Vangalapudi Anitha Home.

ca391c641d12e7.s: Who issued the Gazette notification of 14 October 2025 on the appointment of Justice Subhendu Samanta to the Andhra Pradesh High Court?
o: The Chief Justice of the AP High Court
ca391c641d12e7.x: The Gazette notification dated 14 October 2025 was issued by President Droupadi Murmu.

cafbe55edeb7b8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the AP High Court ruling in the case concerning a trans woman?
o: The charges were quashed on gender grounds.
The case was heard by Justice Venkata Jyothirmai Pratapa.
The petition was filed by Viswanathan Krishnamurthy and his parents against a case by Shabana.
Article 15 bars discrimination on the ground of sex.
cafbe55edeb7b8.x: The charges were quashed for lack of evidence, not on gender grounds.

ca425ce9eb0c8e.s: On which date was the 3% horizontal reservation for meritorious sportspersons in AP direct recruitment notified under the AP Sports Policy 2024–29?
ca425ce9eb0c8e.x: The reservation was notified on 20 April 2025 under the AP Sports Policy 2024–29.

ca289e53a46d5c.s: Under the Swachh Ratham pilot of the Swachh Andhra campaign, villagers exchanged which waste for groceries of equal value?
ca289e53a46d5c.x: Villagers exchanged dry waste for groceries and essentials such as rice, soaps and shampoos; the waste was sold to recyclers.

caaa194c2f0f0f.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Bharati Devi Ranga organised women in the Civil Disobedience movement.
2. Garimella Satyanarayana was known for editing Krishna Patrika.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caaa194c2f0f0f.x: Bharati Devi Ranga organised women in Civil Disobedience; Garimella Satyanarayana was known for patriotic songs, while Krishna Patrika is linked to Konda Venkatappayya.

ca42985da9276d.s: Which of the following pairs (district – ODOP product at the 44th IITF 2025) is INCORRECTLY matched?
ca42985da9276d.x: Chittoor showcased wooden carvings; Uppada sarees came from Kakinada.

ca26b53b76ac64.s: Which organisation organised the 44th India International Trade Fair 2025?
o: Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry
ca26b53b76ac64.x: The 44th IITF 2025 was organised by the India Trade Promotion Organisation; the Andhra Pradesh pavilion was a participant.

cacaee324b2716.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the dolphin pod sighted off Visakhapatnam?
o: The species was the striped dolphin, Stenella coeruleoalba.
The species was the Indian Ocean humpback dolphin, Sousa plumbea.
The species is classified as Least Concern by the IUCN.
The pod was confirmed by the East Coast Conservation Team.
cacaee324b2716.x: The sighted species was the striped dolphin, Stenella coeruleoalba, not the Indian Ocean humpback dolphin.

caee593647cc1a.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. All cetaceans are placed in Schedule II of the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972.
2. The Marine Mammal Research and Conservation Network of India works on marine-mammal conservation.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caee593647cc1a.x: All cetaceans are in Schedule I, not Schedule II; statement 2 is correct.

cab1532b8642d5.s: Who, as Chairman of the Swachh Andhra Corporation, announced that AP would adopt a Circular Economy Policy claimed to be India's first?
cab1532b8642d5.x: Pattabhi Ram Kommareddy, Chairman of the Swachh Andhra Corporation, announced the Circular Economy Policy.

ca0ebba92f903b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the proposed Potti Sriramulu statue in Amaravati?
o: The statue will be 58 ft tall.
Andhra State was formed in 1956 after Potti Sriramulu's death.
The statue is linked to his 125th birth anniversary.
Potti Sriramulu fasted unto death for a separate Andhra State.
ca0ebba92f903b.x: Andhra State was formed in 1953, not 1956.

ca997cd4b222f8.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Tanguturi Prakasam was the first Chief Minister of Andhra State in 1953.
2. He was not the first Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh, which was formed in 1956.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca997cd4b222f8.x: Both are correct: Prakasam was the first CM of Andhra State (1953); Andhra Pradesh was formed later, in 1956.

cac2fa16950544.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Swachh Ratham waste-for-groceries pilot?
o: The collected waste was sold to recyclers.
Drivers of Material Delivery Units repurposed their vehicles as Swachh Rathams.
It covered seven panchayats of Guntur Rural Mandal.
The collected waste was used for biogas production.
cac2fa16950544.x: The dry waste was sold to recyclers, not used for biogas production.

cadbadd7fb0d25.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Chittoor mango-cover initiative?
o: The listed Chittoor varieties included Banganapalle.
Over 1.92 crore covers were distributed across 2,000 acres.
Mangoes protected by the covers fetched double the price.
Powdery mildew and anthracnose affect Chittoor mangoes.
cadbadd7fb0d25.x: The listed varieties were Totapuri, Benishan, Mallika and Alphonso, not Banganapalle.

ca5196b8ca1309.s: The honorific 'Amarajeevi' given to Potti Sriramulu means:
ca5196b8ca1309.x: 'Amarajeevi' means 'immortal soul'; 'Lion of Andhra' (Andhra Kesari) was Tanguturi Prakasam's title.

cad83ce1138506.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Code on Social Security, 2020 gave the first legal definition of gig and platform workers and created a Social Security Fund.
2. The Code on Wages, 2019 gave the first legal definition of gig and platform workers and created a Social Security Fund.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cad83ce1138506.x: These provisions belong to the Code on Social Security, 2020, not the Code on Wages, 2019.

ca101e0a2db9f0.s: Which of the following pairs (Labour Code – number of laws merged) is correctly matched?
ca101e0a2db9f0.x: The OSH Code merged 13 laws; the Code on Wages merged 4, the Social Security Code 9 and the IR Code 3.

ca01c67e115f86.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Industrial Relations Code, 2020?
o: It merged three Central labour laws.
It absorbed the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947.
It raised the permission threshold for layoff, retrenchment and closure from 100 to 500 workers.
It absorbed the Trade Unions Act, 1926.
ca01c67e115f86.x: The threshold for layoff, retrenchment and closure was raised from 100 to 300 workers, not 500.

cadfe282dceccb.s:
Consider the following statements about the OSH Code, 2020:
1. Women are prohibited from working before 6 am or after 7 pm.
2. Appointment letters and an annual free health check are mandatory.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cadfe282dceccb.x: Women may work before 6 am or after 7 pm with consent and safety measures; statement 2 is correct.

ca5f9c51254132.s: In the context of the response to Left-Wing Extremism, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Clear–Hold–Develop – Initiative banned by the Supreme Court
Year of the ban on Salwa Judum – 2011
Authority that banned Salwa Judum – Union Home Ministry
ca5f9c51254132.x: The Supreme Court banned Salwa Judum in 2011; Clear–Hold–Develop is a strategy.

ca2b4351b0bdb6.s: Which of the following was among the four demands of the September 2025 Ladakh protests?
o: Withdrawal of the Sixth Schedule demand
Abolition of job reservation for locals
Abolition of education reservation for locals
ca2b4351b0bdb6.x: Statehood was one of the four demands of the Leh Apex Body and the Kargil Democratic Alliance.

caf020a9b79dad.s: Who coined the term 'provincial citizenship' in the context of domicile politics?
caf020a9b79dad.x: Alok Ranjan of JNU coined the term; Myron Weiner is associated with 'Sons of the Soil'.

cac9065b74d95c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the machine-readable electoral rolls debate?
o: ERONET is the Election Commission's digital application for voter details.
Electoral rolls are prepared by district officials.
Before the 2019 elections, the EC told Chief Electoral Officers to continue uploading machine-readable rolls.
In Kamal Nath vs EC of India (2018), the Supreme Court refused to compel the EC to give machine-readable rolls.
cac9065b74d95c.x: Before the 2019 elections the EC told Chief Electoral Officers to stop uploading machine-readable rolls.

nc96c46c5f49.s: The Industrial Relations Code, 2020 absorbed which of the following laws?
o: Payment of Wages Act, 1936 and Minimum Wages Act, 1948
Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 and Trade Unions Act, 1926
Employees' State Insurance Act, 1948 and EPF Act, 1952
nc96c46c5f49.x: The Industrial Relations Code absorbed the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 and the Trade Unions Act, 1926.

cacf12b0cdd517.s: The Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025 were notified on:
cacf12b0cdd517.x: The DPDP Rules, 2025 were notified on 14 November 2025 to operationalise the DPDP Act, 2023; the draft Rules came in January 2025.

ca3e6f6ec1818e.s:
Consider the following statements about the DPDP framework:
1. A Data Principal is the entity that decides the purpose and means of processing personal data.
2. Withdrawal of consent should be as easy as giving consent.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca3e6f6ec1818e.x: A Data Principal is the individual whose data is processed; the deciding entity is the Data Fiduciary. Statement 2 is correct.

cae8471941f3a9.s: Which provision of the RTI Act, 2005 was amended under the DPDP framework by removing the public-interest override for personal information?
cae8471941f3a9.x: Section 8(1)(j) of the RTI Act, 2005 was amended by removing the public-interest override for personal information.

ca16b27a373d69.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the evolution of the UPSC?
o: The Government of India Act, 1919 first envisaged an independent recruitment body.
The Public Service Commission was set up in October 1924 with Sir Ross Barker as chairman.
The Lee Commission recommended such a body in 1924.
The Government of India Act, 1935 provided for a Federal Public Service Commission.
ca16b27a373d69.x: The Public Service Commission was set up in October 1926, not 1924, with Sir Ross Barker as its first chairman.

cad09498e65a6a.s: Which of the following pairs (e-Courts Project phase – feature) is correctly matched?
o: Phase I (2010–2015) – e-filing, e-payment, NJDG and virtual courts
Phase II (2015–2023) – Case Information System and computerisation of over 14,000 courts
Phase II (2015–2023) – e-filing, e-payment, NJDG and virtual courts
Phase I (2010–2015) – Digitisation of 3,108 crore documents
cad09498e65a6a.x: Phase II introduced e-filing, e-payment, NJDG and virtual courts; Phase I covered the Case Information System and computerisation of over 14,000 courts.

cacf58809c9f2d.s: In X Corp's challenge on take-down requests under the IT Act, 2000, the Karnataka High Court upheld:
o: The Sahyog Portal as an instrument of public good
Section 69A blocking as the only route for every take-down
A ban on agencies sending requests under Section 79(3)(b)
Complete removal of intermediary liability under Section 79
cacf58809c9f2d.x: The High Court upheld the Sahyog Portal as an instrument of public good, through which Central and State agencies and local police may send requests under Section 79(3)(b).

ca7360d224b5c7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about protection against misuse of personality rights in India?
o: There is no single statute governing personality rights.
Sections 38A and 38B of the Copyright Act, 1957 concern performer rights and moral rights.
Article 21 has no relevance to personality-rights protection.
Section 27 of the Trade Marks Act, 1999 provides for passing off.
ca7360d224b5c7.x: Article 21 is one of the legal bases of personality-rights protection, so the claim that it has no relevance is false.

cad6113784f9b7.s: Which of the following pairs relating to Chandigarh is correctly matched?
o: Punjab New Capital (Periphery) Control Act, 1952 – 22 villages of Kharar
Capital of Punjab (Development and Regulation) Act, 1952 – 16 km periphery radius
Land acquired for Chandigarh – 17 villages of Kharar
cad6113784f9b7.x: Haryana was the 17th state; the Periphery Control Act set a 16 km radius and the land acquired came from 22 villages of Kharar.

cac529aeefb954.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Under Article 312, Parliament can create new All-India Services, including an All-India Judicial Service.
2. President Droupadi Murmu backed the All-India Judicial Service on Constitution Day 2023.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac529aeefb954.x: Both are correct: Article 312 empowers Parliament to create new All-India Services, and the President backed the AIJS on Constitution Day 2023.

ca3b12989cc14d.s: Which of the following was part of the Supreme Court's May 2025 framework for the district judiciary?
o: Qualifying service reduced from 5 years to 3 years
Civil Judge entry to require 5 years' practice
Quotas fixed on vacancies rather than sanctioned strength
ca3b12989cc14d.x: The framework reduced qualifying service from 5 to 3 years, restored LDCE at 25%, required 3 years' practice for Civil Judge entry and fixed quotas on sanctioned strength.

caf3b674710263.s: Which form is used to object to the inclusion or deletion of a name in the electoral roll?
caf3b674710263.x: Form-7 is used to object to the inclusion or deletion of a name in the electoral roll.

ca981ee3c69529.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about criminal defamation in India?
o: It is dealt with under Sections 499 and 500 of the IPC.
The punishment may be imprisonment, fine or both.
Subramanian Swamy v. Union of India (2016) upheld it.
ca981ee3c69529.x: Sections 499 and 500 of the IPC provide for up to 2 years' imprisonment, fine or both, not 3 years.

ca2d7e38756d7e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about removal of arrested Ministers under the Constitution (130th Amendment) Bill, 2025?
o: It applies to offences punishable with 5 years or more imprisonment.
It requires detention for 31 consecutive days.
If the PM's advice is not tendered by the 31st day, the person automatically ceases to be a Minister.
The person may be re-appointed after release from custody under Article 75(1).
ca2d7e38756d7e.x: The trigger is detention for 30 consecutive days, with removal by the 31st day; 31 days of detention is wrong.

ca688d4f0787dd.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the classification of games under the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025?
o: E-sports require registration and may charge entry fees and give performance-based prizes.
Real Money Games are completely banned.
Online social games may include betting and wagering.
Online social games are casual or educational and are promoted by the government.
ca688d4f0787dd.x: Online social games involve no betting or wagering.

ca5f780a6d6942.s: The IIM (Amendment) Bill, 2025 provides for the 22nd Indian Institute of Management at:
ca5f780a6d6942.x: The Bill creates the 22nd IIM at Guwahati, Assam.

cad4a70209bf06.s:
Consider the following statements about the IIM (Amendment) Bill, 2025:
1. It amends the Indian Institutes of Management Act, 2017.
2. Admissions to the 22nd IIM are scheduled to begin from 2025–26.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cad4a70209bf06.x: Both are correct: the Bill amends the IIM Act, 2017, and admissions to the new IIM are scheduled from 2025–26.

ca7bbec3ac8595.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Constitution (130th Amendment) Bill, 2025 seeks to amend Article 75.
2. Article 75 provides that Ministers hold office during the pleasure of the President.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca7bbec3ac8595.x: Both are correct: the Bill amends Article 75, which provides that Ministers hold office during the President's pleasure.

cadfd121be7b67.s: Under the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Offering Real Money Games – Up to 2 years and fine up to ₹50 lakh
Advertising Real Money Games – Up to 3 years and fine up to ₹1 crore
Nature of offences – Cognisable and non-bailable
cadfd121be7b67.x: Offences are cognisable and non-bailable; offering RMGs carries up to 3 years and ₹1 crore, advertising up to 2 years and ₹50 lakh, and foreign operators are blocked through Interpol.

ca262eb60a291b.s: Under the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025, who is NOT penalised in relation to online money games?
o: Those carrying out fund transactions for such games
ca262eb60a291b.x: The Act imposes no penalty on players; penalties apply to operators, those handling fund transactions and advertisers.

ca53dbc7122480.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Draft Registration Bill, 2025?
o: It was released by the Ministry of Rural Development for public comments.
It seeks to replace the Registration Act, 1908.
It reduces the penalty from 7 years' imprisonment to 3 years.
ca53dbc7122480.x: The draft provides that registration cannot be denied for lack of Aadhaar.

cabf5298545cbb.s:
Consider the following statements about the 42nd Amendment, 1976:
1. It was described as the 'Mini-Constitution'.
2. It added 'Socialist' and 'Secular' to the Preamble.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cabf5298545cbb.x: Both are correct: the 42nd Amendment is known as the 'Mini-Constitution' and added 'Socialist' and 'Secular' to the Preamble.

ca7a12cef0219f.s: The Draft Registration Bill, 2025 was proposed as land and property disputes make up about what share of civil cases?
ca7a12cef0219f.x: Land and property disputes account for over two-thirds of civil cases.

ca6818a68c07db.s:
Consider the following statements about AP's Scheduled Caste sub-categorisation:
1. The AP Cabinet chaired by N. Chandrababu Naidu approved a draft Ordinance on it.
2. Its first use is for recruitment to State civil services.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca6818a68c07db.x: The Cabinet approved the draft Ordinance, but its first use is for DSC teacher recruitment, not State civil services.

cab5d2c7dfc75b.s: On which date was the ECI expected to announce the pan-India Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls?
cab5d2c7dfc75b.x: The ECI was to announce the pan-India SIR on 27 October 2025, with the first phase covering 10–15 States/UTs including Tamil Nadu, West Bengal, Kerala, Assam and Puducherry.

cae4f04a519ec4.s: Which of the following is NOT an option for a Governor under Article 200?
o: Reserving a Bill for the Supreme Court
Returning a non-Money Bill for reconsideration
cae4f04a519ec4.x: Article 200 allows reservation of a Bill for the President, not the Supreme Court.

ca15a6bdac67a5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about geotagging under Census 2027?
o: All buildings will be geotagged during Houselisting Operations.
Geotagging will be done during Population Enumeration.
Houselisting Operations are scheduled for April–September 2026.
A Digital Layout Mapping app will be used with the Houselisting Block as the unit.
ca15a6bdac67a5.x: Geotagging will be done during Houselisting Operations, not Population Enumeration.

cabaaf43619997.s: The Presidential Reference on Governors' delay on Bills followed an April 2025 Supreme Court ruling on the Governor of which State?
cabaaf43619997.x: An April 2025 two-judge Bench held Tamil Nadu Governor R.N. Ravi's delay unconstitutional, set timelines under Article 142 and held pocket veto unconstitutional.

cadac0c6747ddb.s: Which of the following pairs (commission – recommendation on Bills) is correctly matched?
o: Sarkaria Commission – Governor to decide on Bills within six months
Punchhi Commission – Governor to decide on Bills within six months
cadac0c6747ddb.x: The Punchhi Commission (2010) recommended that the Governor decide on Bills within six months; Sarkaria (1987) said discretion only in rare cases and the President to dispose of reserved Bills in six months.

ca3f29de7d823d.s: What 'first' was associated with the case that led to the Presidential Reference on assent to Bills?
o: Judicially enforceable timelines were imposed on Governors and the President
Pocket veto was upheld by the Supreme Court
Governors' discretion under Article 163 was abolished
ca3f29de7d823d.x: The case marked the first time judicially enforceable timelines were imposed on Governors and the President.

caabbbfe57d9ce.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Article 143(2) concerns disputes on pre-Constitution treaties and agreements.
2. In a Reference, the Supreme Court can directly overrule its own precedent.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caabbbfe57d9ce.x: Statement 1 is correct; in a Reference the Court can only clarify its precedent or suggest a larger bench, not overrule it.

cac3598d1b4e3b.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Election Commission's powers under Article 324 are plenary but operate within constitutional limits.
2. The burden of proving citizenship lies on existing voters rather than on new registrants.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac3598d1b4e3b.x: Statement 1 is correct; the burden of proving citizenship lies on new registrants, not existing voters.

ca5d11c1e8b9c8.s: In the context of responses to the crisis of journalism, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Whistle Blowers Protection Act – Non-profit model
ca5d11c1e8b9c8.x: The Whistle Blowers Protection Act dates from 2014 and was poorly implemented; ProPublica is a US non-profit model.

caf3d231a358c2.s: What did the Supreme Court's order of 10 July 2025 on the Bihar Special Intensive Revision do?
o: Stayed the Bihar SIR and barred Aadhaar
Did not stay the SIR and ordered draft-roll publication with Aadhaar inclusion
Transferred the SIR to the State Election Commission
Made the SIR subject to Union Cabinet approval
caf3d231a358c2.x: The order framed whether the ECI could conduct SIR, did not stay the Bihar SIR, and ordered draft-roll publication and Aadhaar inclusion.

cac62590cdb2a7.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Supreme Court's decision on the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025?
o: The Central Waqf Council may have at most three non-Muslim members out of 22.
Section 3C, letting an officer declare waqf property as government property on doubt, was stayed.
Title disputes are to be decided by the Waqf Tribunal under Section 83.
Mandatory registration, required since 1923, was upheld.
cac62590cdb2a7.x: The Central Waqf Council may have up to four non-Muslim members out of 22, not three.

ca31941e4c4ed0.s:
Consider the following statements about the Vice-President of India:
1. A candidate must be at least 35 years old.
2. A candidate must not hold an office of profit.
3. The Vice-President is not eligible for re-election.
Which of the above statements are correct?
ca31941e4c4ed0.x: A candidate must be a citizen, at least 35 and not hold an office of profit; the term is five years and re-election is allowed.

caca218cce7fa5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Supreme Court's decision on the Waqf (Amendment) Act, 2025?
o: The Act's validity was upheld overall.
Mandatory registration of waqfs was upheld.
Religious practice ceases at protected monuments.
The Court referred to Section 5(6) of the AMASR Act, 1958.
caca218cce7fa5.x: The Court held that religious practice continues at protected monuments, referring to Section 5(6) of the AMASR Act, 1958.

cac061ec4313cc.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Article 30(1) recognises minorities' right to establish and administer educational institutions.
2. The RTE Act bans the Teacher Eligibility Test for teachers.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac061ec4313cc.x: Article 30(1) protects minority educational institutions; the RTE framework provides for TET and instead bans capitation fees and corporal punishment.

ca7747d40070b5.s: R. Rajagopal v. State of Tamil Nadu (1994) recognised which aspect of personality rights under Article 21?
o: The right to control one's identity
ca7747d40070b5.x: R. Rajagopal (1994) recognised the right to control one's identity under Article 21.

ca9ab724b8ce19.s:
Consider the following statements about the Kerala hijab-row debate:
1. Articles 14 and 21A are linked with institutional autonomy.
2. Articles 19(1)(g) and 21 are linked with education.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca9ab724b8ce19.x: Both are wrong: Article 19(1)(g) relates to institutional autonomy, while Article 21/21A represents the education angle.

ca71149c781722.s:
Consider the following statements about the Election Commission of India:
1. Election Commissioners hold office for six years or until 65, and the CEC is removable only like a Supreme Court judge.
2. The ECI advises the President and Governors on disqualification under Articles 103 and 192.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca71149c781722.x: Both are correct: tenure is six years or age 65 with the CEC protected like an SC judge, and the ECI advises on disqualification under Articles 103 and 192.

cae7717ac70e20.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Federalism is part of the Basic Structure, as recognised in Kesavananda Bharati (1973).
2. The Rajya Sabha is provided for under Article 83.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cae7717ac70e20.x: Both are correct: federalism is part of the Basic Structure (Kesavananda Bharati, 1973), and Article 83 concerns the Rajya Sabha.

ca4083696f96fc.s: ECINET was first used in bypolls held in Kerala, Gujarat, Punjab and West Bengal on:
ca4083696f96fc.x: ECINET was first used in the 19 June 2025 bypolls; 4 May was the announcement date and results came on 23 June.

ca91e2f1d8d60a.s: Which of the following pairs relating to emergency provisions is INCORRECTLY matched?
ca91e2f1d8d60a.x: President's Rule is under Article 356; Article 360 deals with Financial Emergency.

ca4940a0d2d7f6.s: Under the proposed Uttarakhand UCC Rules, 2025 amendments, which offence–penalty pair is correctly matched?
o: Live-in relationship with a minor – Up to 7 years
Bigamy or live-in while married – Up to 6 months or ₹50,000
Forced or fraudulent marriage – Up to 3 months or ₹25,000
Non-registration or false declaration – Up to 3 months or ₹25,000
ca4940a0d2d7f6.x: Non-registration or false declaration carries up to 3 months or ₹25,000; live-in with a minor up to 6 months or ₹50,000; bigamy up to 7 years; forced marriage up to 7 years plus fine.

ca7bd452967163.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Immigration and Foreigners (Exemption) Order, 2025?
o: It exempts citizens of Nepal and Bhutan from passport and visa requirements.
It grants citizenship to all persons covered by it.
It covers registered Sri Lankan Tamil refugees who sheltered in India on or before 9 January 2015.
It covers specified Tibetan refugees and certain minorities from Afghanistan, Pakistan and Bangladesh.
ca7bd452967163.x: The Order only exempts specified categories from passport and visa requirements; it does not confer citizenship.

ca11077237ccfa.s: What change regarding detention did the Immigration and Foreigners Order, 2025 bring?
o: It abolished detention and holding centres
It limited detention powers to Assam
It made detention subject to Parliament's approval
It gave a clear legal basis for detention for the first time
ca11077237ccfa.x: The Order provided a clear legal basis for detention for the first time.

ca84c90f599ad9.s: After the Supreme Court struck down the IMDT Act, 1983 in 2005, the 11 IMDTs:
o: Were merged with the Gauhati High Court
Were converted into NRC Seva Kendras
ca84c90f599ad9.x: After the IMDT Act, 1983 was struck down in 2005, the 11 IMDTs became Foreigners Tribunals.

ca7951d7e06318.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Assam Police summoned The Wire's Siddharth Varadarajan and Karan Thapar under Section 152 of the BNS.
2. The summons related to coverage of Operation Sindoor.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca7951d7e06318.x: Both are correct: the editors were summoned under Section 152 BNS over coverage of Operation Sindoor.

cadd21103c96e1.s: Under AP's Ordinance on SC sub-categorisation, the whole State is initially treated as one unit on the basis of which census?
cadd21103c96e1.x: The whole State is one unit based on the 2011 census; after the next census, all 26 districts become units.

ca1476b72292c8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about Chandigarh?
o: The Governor of Haryana has been its Administrator since 1984.
It is a Union Territory and the joint capital of Punjab and Haryana.
Property between Punjab and Haryana is divided in the ratio 60:40.
It became Punjab's capital in 1953 and was inaugurated by President Rajendra Prasad.
ca1476b72292c8.x: Since 1984 the Governor of Punjab, not Haryana, has been the Administrator of Chandigarh.

ca5c03e872152b.s: Under the NDPS Act, 1985, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Charas – Flowering or fruiting tops containing THC
Ganja – Resin of cannabis, including hashish oil
Charas – Resin of cannabis, including hashish oil
Ganja – Seeds and leaves of cannabis only
ca5c03e872152b.x: Charas is the resin of cannabis, including hashish oil; ganja is the flowering or fruiting tops containing THC.

ca38c3058bb3b8.s: The UN Commission on Narcotic Drugs, founded in 1946, is headquartered in:
ca38c3058bb3b8.x: The UN Commission on Narcotic Drugs, founded in 1946, has its headquarters in Vienna.

ca88898b07e82a.s: The Hindu's open-source journalism probe into voter-list manipulation concerned which place?
ca88898b07e82a.x: The Hindu's probe concerned voter-list manipulation in Aland, Karnataka.

ca97c23e1d5657.s: Which of the following pairs of case and principle is correctly matched?
o: Manoj Narula v Union of India – Floor test
Rai Sahib Ram Jawaya Kapur v State of Punjab – Parliamentary accountability
S.R. Bommai v Union of India – PM's advice binding unless constitutionally disqualified
Manoj Narula v Union of India – Legislative supremacy
ca97c23e1d5657.x: Ram Jawaya Kapur concerned parliamentary accountability; Manoj Narula concerned the PM's advice, and S.R. Bommai the floor test and legislative supremacy.

ca3dad8d152203.s: In the June 2025 bypolls using ECINET, who uploaded voter turnout directly before leaving the polling station?
ca3dad8d152203.x: Presiding officers uploaded turnout figures directly before leaving the polling station.

caac853634210d.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the UPSC?
o: It recruits for technical and medical services.
It recruits for forest, engineering and statistical services.
It entered its centenary year on 1 October 2025.
It recruits only for the civil services.
caac853634210d.x: UPSC recruits not only for civil services but also for technical, medical, forest, engineering and statistical services.

caac6184e6ff50.s: Which former Maoist Politburo member surrendered saying Chinese and Russian models were irrelevant?
caac6184e6ff50.x: Mallojula Venugopal Rao, a former Politburo member, surrendered and said Chinese and Russian models were irrelevant.

ca2c01ec4ec233.s: Apart from the Jaish-e-Mohammed initiative, which groups were cited as using women in militant activities?
o: Boko Haram, Abu Sayyaf and ULFA
ca2c01ec4ec233.x: LTTE, ISIS and Hamas were cited as other groups using women in militant activities.

caa75d86cbfd8a.s: Who was the petitioner in the MGNREGS case concerning West Bengal?
caa75d86cbfd8a.x: Paschim Banga Khet Majoor Samity was the petitioner; Anuradha Talwar is convenor of NREGA Sangharsh Morcha.

cab81739fdb1e3.s: Who launched the 'Your Capital, Your Right' campaign on 4 October 2025?
cab81739fdb1e3.x: Nirmala Sitharaman launched it on 4 October 2025 in Gandhinagar; RBI, SEBI and PFRDA were partners.

ca395cfd278012.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the GST 2.0 restructuring?
o: Sin and demerit goods such as cigarettes and paan masala attract 40%.
The 12% and 28% slabs were retained along with 5% and 18%.
The new 5% and 18% slabs took effect on 22 September 2025.
Compensation cess on tobacco continues until the loans are repaid.
ca395cfd278012.x: The 12% and 28% slabs were dropped; 0%, 5% and 18% remain with a 40% demerit rate.

ca2d46ede90cfa.s: Which of the following was an economic implication of the GST 2.0 restructuring?
o: Introduction of an inverted duty structure
Correction of the inverted duty structure
ca2d46ede90cfa.x: GST 2.0 included correction of the inverted duty structure.

caf73ab2e755fb.s: Under the GST changes effective 22 September 2025, which of the following attracts zero GST?
o: Non-ICU hospital rooms above ₹5,000 per day
caf73ab2e755fb.x: Individual health and life insurance and reinsurance were given zero GST.

cac971432b5e47.s:
Consider the following statements about GST 2.0 (effective 22 September 2025):
1. Individual health insurance was placed under Nil GST.
2. Life-saving cancer drugs were placed under Nil GST.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cac971432b5e47.x: Both are correct: individual health insurance and life-saving cancer drugs were placed under Nil GST.

cabf6e39396574.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the GST treatment of cigarettes under the 22 September 2025 changes?
o: Cigarettes were moved to the 40% sin slab without the 28% GST-plus-cess structure.
The effective burden on cigarettes is 52–88%.
The change took effect from 22 September 2025.
cabf6e39396574.x: The specified treatment for cigarettes was 28% GST plus cess, giving an effective burden of 52–88%.

cae23a8d973d84.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about GST on health care from 22 September 2025?
o: Hospital rooms below ₹5,000 per day are exempt.
ICU, CCU, ICCU and NICU rooms are exempt.
Non-ICU rooms above ₹5,000 per day attract 18% GST without ITC.
Individual health insurance attracts Nil GST.
cae23a8d973d84.x: Non-ICU rooms above ₹5,000 per day attract 5% GST without ITC, not 18%.

cab9507f9a9d44.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the proposed GST rate rationalisation and compensation to States?
o: The final decision rests with the Group of Ministers chaired by Samrat Choudhary.
The compensation cess is proposed to be abolished.
The final decision rests with the GST Council chaired by the Union Finance Minister.
The GST Council meeting was expected in September 2025.
cab9507f9a9d44.x: The Group of Ministers accepted the Centre's proposal, but the final decision rests with the GST Council.

caa3f327f0cee7.s: In August 2025, what did SEBI propose to replace the grey market for trading shares before IPO listing?
o: A regulated venue for pre-listing trading
A ban on transfer of IPO allotments
A SEBI-run grey market price index
caa3f327f0cee7.x: SEBI proposed a regulated venue for trading shares before IPO listing to replace the grey market.

ca8c8058816d07.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The 11% cotton import duty was withdrawn until 31 October 2025.
2. The duty had been introduced in Union Budget 2021 to protect farmers.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca8c8058816d07.x: The duty was withdrawn until 30 September 2025, not 31 October; it was introduced in Budget 2021 to protect farmers.

caf503374ffe9c.s: Which of the following cotton-related pairs is correctly matched?
o: 2024-25 production and requirement – 350 and 335 lakh bales
2021 production and requirement – 294 and 318 lakh bales
caf503374ffe9c.x: About six million farmers grow cotton; 2024-25 production and requirement were 294 and 318 lakh bales, and 2021 figures were 350 and 335 lakh bales.

ca9d2f115d3b35.s: Which survey is MoSPI scheduled to conduct across India from February 2026?
ca9d2f115d3b35.x: MoSPI will conduct India's first pan-India National Household Income Survey from February 2026; the debt and situation surveys are for July 2026–June 2027.

ca589daedf31c0.s: Who is the MoSPI Secretary associated with India's first National Household Income Survey?
ca589daedf31c0.x: Saurabh Garg is the Secretary of MoSPI.

caa7239ce2e917.s: India's insurance penetration was what share of GDP, against the world figure of 6.8%?
caa7239ce2e917.x: India's insurance penetration was 3.7% of GDP, compared with 6.8% globally.

ca93e875f48e11.s: The original GST compensation to States, provided for five years from July 2017, ended in:
ca93e875f48e11.x: The compensation arrangement ran for 5 years from July 2017 through the compensation cess and ended in June 2022.

ca1e91a7eda898.s: Which RBI Governor was reported ready with liquidity support amid the tariff-related disruption?
ca1e91a7eda898.x: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra was reported to be ready with liquidity support.

ca16ccc9093d67.s: In the India–US trade talks of June 2025, which issues were the principal sticking points?
ca16ccc9093d67.x: Agriculture and dairy were the main sticking points, over small producers and hormones in US milk.

cae3e22dd60d0d.s: In the context of the June 2025 India–US trade talks, which pair is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: Deadline for avoiding reciprocal tariffs – 9 July 2025
Withdrawal of India's GSP status – 9 July 2025
Alternative routes to Hormuz – Chabahar and INSTC
Initial arrangement – Mini trade deal, then first BTA tranche by Fall 2025
cae3e22dd60d0d.x: India's GSP status was withdrawn in 2019; 9 July 2025 was the reciprocal-tariff deadline.

ca092e3110b8f8.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. FPI selling and the unwinding of the Japanese yen carry trade added to the rupee's weakness.
2. The RBI extended the period for realising export proceeds from 9 months to 15 months.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca092e3110b8f8.x: Both are correct: FPI selling and the yen carry-trade unwind pressured the rupee, and the RBI extended export-proceeds realisation from 9 to 15 months.

caa0337cc0105b.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
o: NEER – Rupee against a currency basket without inflation adjustment
Rise in NEER – Appreciation of the rupee
Rise in REER – Gain in competitiveness
caa0337cc0105b.x: A rise in REER indicates a loss of competitiveness, not a gain.

caac010558f28d.s: India's foreign-exchange reserves (FCA, gold, SDRs and Reserve Tranche Position) are:
o: Held by the RBI and owned by the Government of India
Held and owned by the RBI
Held and owned by the Government of India
Held by the Government of India and owned by the RBI
caac010558f28d.x: The reserves are held by the RBI but owned by the Government of India.

ca4941ead87dff.s: Uttar Pradesh's Women's Economic Empowerment Index is India's first such index at the ____ level.
ca4941ead87dff.x: Uttar Pradesh has India's first district-level Women's Economic Empowerment Index.

ca4673702b0230.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's dairy sector?
o: Its competitiveness comes from low labour costs.
Its competitiveness comes from high yields per cow.
India lacks land for New Zealand-style pasture dairying.
ca4673702b0230.x: India's competitiveness comes from low labour costs, not high yields per cow.

caaee8f8414f22.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Grey Market Premium (GMP) is the premium for selling IPO application rights.
2. The Kostak rate is the premium for selling IPO application rights.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caaee8f8414f22.x: The Kostak rate is the premium for selling IPO application rights; GMP is not that.

cae0246ae65513.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about South Asian trade integration?
o: Intra-regional trade under SAFTA is only 5–7% of total trade.
SAARC trade is $23 billion against a potential of $67 billion.
Bangladesh has the highest unexploited trade potential, at 86%.
Intra-SAARC trade costs are 114% of goods value, against 109% for trade with the US.
cae0246ae65513.x: Bangladesh's unexploited trade potential is 93%; 86% is the overall unexploited potential.

caf6818573ed33.s: Which US tariff on Indian goods was cited in the RBI MPC preview for 29 September–1 October 2025?
caf6818573ed33.x: The US tariff on Indian goods cited was 50%.

ca4b77fa706783.s:
Consider the following statements about the landscape approach to India's green economy:
1. India is projected to have 35 million green jobs by 2030.
2. The approach is associated with 2 lakh PRIs.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca4b77fa706783.x: 35 million green jobs are projected by 2030; the PRI figure is 2.5 lakh, not 2 lakh.

cab473a0f1c909.s: Which of the following pairs (sector – US tariff change) is correctly matched?
cab473a0f1c909.x: Shrimp went from 10% to 60%; jewellery 2.1% to 52.1%, carpets 2.9% to 52.9% and organic chemicals 4% to 54%.

ca6cc1c46197cc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the approved rail multi-tracking projects?
o: They are to be completed by 2031-32.
They cover four sections across Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat and Chhattisgarh.
They come under the PM Gati Shakti National Master Plan.
ca6cc1c46197cc.x: The projects are to be completed by 2030-31, not 2031-32.

ca130e3868f642.s: Which of the following pairs (coal-sector tool – role) is correctly matched?
o: Mines Surveillance System – Coal allocation monitoring
ca130e3868f642.x: Uttam concerns coal quality; Koyla Shakti integrates coal, transport, power and state data, and CAMS monitors coal allocation.

caffa42e229519.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Smart Cities Mission in Andhra Pradesh?
o: Over 84% of the projects have been completed.
The completed projects are worth ₹6,200 crore.
The progress covers Amaravati, Kakinada, Tirupati and Visakhapatnam.
₹6,200 crore is the value of AMRUT project DPRs.
caffa42e229519.x: The completed Smart Cities projects are worth ₹5,701 crore; ₹6,200 crore is the value of AMRUT DPRs.

ca3e8061a3fbcc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct according to the PowerPulse Q1 FY26 report?
o: Peak demand reached 242 GW in June 2025.
Renewable additions by listed power companies were 4.6 GW in April–June 2025.
The 2032 thermal capacity target was revised to 80 GW from 95 GW.
Thermal additions were 1.9 GW in April–June 2025.
ca3e8061a3fbcc.x: The 2032 thermal target was raised to 95 GW from 80 GW, not cut.

cacb84c2bbd4c1.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's solar industry?
o: Module manufacturing capacity rose from 2 GW in 2014 to about 100 GW in 2025.
India exported about 4 GW of solar modules to China in 2024.
The 2030 target of 500 GW non-fossil capacity expects 250–280 GW from solar.
Indian modules are 1.5–2 times costlier than Chinese modules.
cacb84c2bbd4c1.x: India exported about 4 GW of solar modules to the US in 2024, not to China.

caf4b2bdb647fc.s: Which digital-economy target was linked to the cyber-fraud concerns highlighted in October 2025?
caf4b2bdb647fc.x: The target is a US$1 trillion digital economy by 2030.

ca98268a9f467f.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India had 117 GW of installed solar capacity in September 2025, with effective capacity of about 85 GW.
2. Solar power achieved parity with coal around 2018.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca98268a9f467f.x: Statement 1 is correct; solar reached parity with coal around 2017, not 2018.

ca8a84570d8ace.s: Coal accounts for about what share of India's electricity generation?
ca8a84570d8ace.x: Coal provides about 70% of electricity and about 55–60% of energy supply.

cafab85f24eeb6.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the planned new coal capacity is correctly matched?
o: Planned total new coal capacity – 97 GW by 2035
Coal capacity in renewable-rich States – 27 GW
Coal capacity in other areas – 70 GW
Intended operating period of the plants – Till 2047
cafab85f24eeb6.x: The plan is 97 GW by 2035: 70 GW in renewable-rich States and 27 GW elsewhere, to run till 2050.

cae6f9230b660f.s: Which organisation did the CEA task with testing battery storage at coal plants for grid balancing?
cae6f9230b660f.x: The CEA tasked NTPC with testing battery storage at coal plants as solar power grows.

caadbf9e3262b5.s: Which institution reported in August 2025 that solar module manufacturing capacity had reached about 100 GW, raising oversupply concerns?
caadbf9e3262b5.x: The report was released by SBI Capital Markets (SBICAPS) in August 2025.

ca38069d1bcc9c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Bharat International Rice Conference (BIRC) 2025?
o: The Department of Commerce and APEDA are giving it financial support.
It will be held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
The Indian Rice Exporters' Federation is the organiser.
ca38069d1bcc9c.x: The Department of Commerce and APEDA give non-financial support only.

ca79963a0ab161.s: India's rice exports in FY 2024–25, its largest agricultural export, were valued at:
ca79963a0ab161.x: India's rice exports in FY 2024–25 were worth US$12.95 billion.

ca0312f65f81c4.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Agriculture Export Policy was introduced in 2018.
2. One District One Product (ODOP) is linked to the Agriculture Export Policy context.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca0312f65f81c4.x: Both are correct: the Agriculture Export Policy dates to 2018 and ODOP is cited in the same context.

cac7c3a890aca8.s: Which State's aqua-product shipments to the US were halted within 24 hours of the 26% US tariff announcement?
cac7c3a890aca8.x: Andhra Pradesh's aqua-product shipments to the US were halted within 24 hours of the 26% tariff announcement.

ca9fc891d0b5cd.s: Which competing seafood exporter faced only a 10% US tariff, compared with Indian aqua exports?

cabb5b42008549.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. India imports about 70% of the chips it uses.
2. Taiwan dominates advanced semiconductor nodes below 5 nm.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
cabb5b42008549.x: India imports about 90% of its chips, not 70%; statement 2 is correct.

ca478f67217a30.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Only 46.2% of graduates are employable.
2. The German dual system and India's National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme are models of academia–industry partnership.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca478f67217a30.x: The employability figure is 42.6%, not 46.2%; statement 2 is correct.

ca530b1bec55ee.s: The India Semiconductor Mission was established in:
ca530b1bec55ee.x: The India Semiconductor Mission was established in 2021.

ca031b968fc234.s: The International Solar Alliance, launched by India and France at COP21 in 2015, is headquartered at:
ca031b968fc234.x: The ISA was launched by India and France in 2015 at COP21 and is headquartered at Gurugram.

ca5644b6a11208.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. East and North-Eastern India account for two-thirds of India's bioeconomy value.
2. Women hold only 11% of rooftop solar jobs.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca5644b6a11208.x: Two-thirds of bioeconomy value comes from Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, Gujarat and Andhra Pradesh; women hold only 11% of rooftop solar jobs.

ca1f89a2cf70cc.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. In India, farmers receive 55–57% of the retail price of milk.
2. The price of corn in India is ₹15.4 per kg.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca1f89a2cf70cc.x: Statement 1 is correct; ₹15.4 per kg is the US corn price, while India's is ₹22–23 per kg.

cadbece3c43824.s: Which of the following is a crypto-backed stablecoin?
cadbece3c43824.x: DAI is crypto-backed (by Ethereum); USDT and USDC are fiat-backed and TerraUSD was algorithmic.

cadf2ed98e288f.s:
Consider the following statements about semiconductors:
1. Silicon, germanium and gallium arsenide are semiconductor materials.
2. N-type doping produces electrons as charge carriers.
3. P-type doping produces electrons as charge carriers.
Which of the above statements are correct?
cadf2ed98e288f.x: Si, Ge and GaAs are semiconductors; N-type material has electrons and P-type material has holes.

ca76a7f040dc5b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about SEBI's proposal on FPIs in commodity derivatives?
o: It covers non-cash-settled, non-agricultural derivatives such as gold, silver, zinc and lead.
It seeks to allow FPIs in agricultural commodity derivatives.
It aims to improve far-month liquidity, price discovery and domestic hedging.
FPIs are now allowed only in cash or financially settled non-agricultural contracts.
ca76a7f040dc5b.x: The proposal concerns non-agricultural commodity derivatives, not agricultural ones.

ca2ea14c7b689e.s: In the Supreme Court's directions on DISCOMs, a 'regulatory asset' is:
o: A gap when ARR exceeds ACS, refunded to consumers
A gap when ACS exceeds ARR, deferred for later recovery with interest
A gap when ACS exceeds ARR, written off by the State
The capital asset base of a DISCOM
ca2ea14c7b689e.x: A regulatory asset is the gap when Average Cost of Supply exceeds Annual Revenue Requirement, deferred for later recovery with interest.

cae9a9d6eebc22.s: Which of the following pairs relating to electricity regulation is correctly matched?
o: RIIO – Fuel and Power Purchase Cost Adjustment
cae9a9d6eebc22.x: RAB is Regulated Asset Base; FPPCA is Fuel and Power Purchase Cost Adjustment and RIIO is Revenue = Incentives + Innovation + Outputs (UK models).

cac99d5adca980.s: Which Chief Minister is associated with the 55-km Musi stretch within HMDA limits under the Musi Riverfront Development Project?
cac99d5adca980.x: Telangana CM A. Revanth Reddy is associated with the 55-km Musi stretch within HMDA limits.

ca1c57e42314df.s: Which of the following Musi Riverfront project pairs is correctly matched?
ca1c57e42314df.x: The Gateway of Hyderabad is at Kothwalguda; Gandhi Sarovar is at Bapu Ghat, the Shiva temple at Manchirevula, and the Charminar mosque is heritage restoration.

cabedeb4f9b18c.s: Which Andhra Pradesh metro project was reported to be about 38 km long?
cabedeb4f9b18c.x: The Vijayawada Metro was reported to be about 38 km long.

ca737ccf2a2f2f.s: India's tiger population, cited in the Tribal Affairs Ministry's conservation policy, rose from about 1,411 in 2006 to over ____ in 2023.
ca737ccf2a2f2f.x: Tigers increased from about 1,411 in 2006 to over 3,000 in 2023.

ca92c1b6aa70ce.s: Which of the following pension-scheme pairs is correctly matched?
o: UPS – 50% of last basic plus DA
NPS – 50% of last basic plus DA
ca92c1b6aa70ce.x: NPS pension is a market annuity; OPS gives 50% of last basic plus DA and UPS 50% of the average basic of the last 12 months for 25 years' service.

caa422f5c2c3c6.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Under the NPS, 40% of the corpus is withdrawn tax-free and 60% is used for annuity.
2. The choice of the UPS is reversible.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caa422f5c2c3c6.x: Both are wrong: under NPS 60% is withdrawn tax-free and 40% goes to annuity, and the UPS choice is irreversible.

ca36c473b49fa2.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Employees contribute under the Unified Pension Scheme.
2. The National Pension System for government employees began in 2005.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca36c473b49fa2.x: Employee contribution is required under UPS; NPS for government employees began in 2004, not 2005.

ca7676f9ef60ee.s: Which item in the 8th Central Pay Commission's Terms of Reference signals concern about a return to the Old Pension Scheme?
o: The cost of the Unified Pension Scheme
The funded cost of contributory pension schemes
The unfunded cost of market annuity schemes
The unfunded cost of non-contributory pension schemes
ca7676f9ef60ee.x: The ToR include the unfunded cost of non-contributory pension schemes, signalling concern about a return to OPS.

cae0aeba90a129.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's response to non-communicable diseases (NCDs)?
o: NP-NCD is part of the response to NCDs.
An HPV vaccine rollout was planned.
Front-of-pack labelling follows the Thailand model.
NCDs cause 63% of deaths in India, according to UNICEF India.
cae0aeba90a129.x: Front-of-pack labelling follows the Singapore model, not Thailand's.

ca516f744ed692.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the proposed Sammakkasagar barrage?
o: It is proposed at Tupakulagudem in Mulugu district on the Godavari.
It will store 6.7 tmcft at FRL +83 m.
It has in-principle approval from Chhattisgarh CM Vishnu Deo Sai but still needs CWC approval.
Submergence in Chhattisgarh was studied by the Central Water Commission.
ca516f744ed692.x: The submergence study was done by IIT Kharagpur, not the Central Water Commission.

ca18ab552b2e1b.s: Under the Draft Seeds Bill, 2025, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Varieties notified under the Seeds Act, 1966 – Deemed registered
Seeds sold in the market – Three-year provisional registration
ca18ab552b2e1b.x: Varieties notified under the 1966 Act are deemed registered; market seeds need VCU-based registration, existing varieties get three-year provisional registration, and VCU means Value for Cultivation and Use.

ca00285a73a2f6.s: According to NCRB 2023 data, illness, the second-largest cause of suicides after family problems, accounted for what share?
ca00285a73a2f6.x: Illness accounted for 19% of suicides, second after family problems (32%).

caf183810a6d54.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about NCRB 2023 data on atrocities against SCs and STs?
o: Cases against STs numbered 12,960, an increase of 18.8%.
Cases against SCs numbered 57,789, an increase of 0.4%.
Over 60% of PoA cases were pending, per the National Campaign on Dalit Human Rights.
The SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act was enacted in 1989.
caf183810a6d54.x: Cases against STs rose by 28.8%, not 18.8%.

ca52a5e3e2e4bf.s: In the discussion on atrocities against SCs and STs, which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
ca52a5e3e2e4bf.x: The Dalit Panthers are linked to the 1970s; Myrdal to the 'soft state' and Dumont to the purity-pollution hierarchy.

caa501e50acac8.s: Which of the following pairs (country – procurement model) is correctly matched?
caa501e50acac8.x: South Korea is linked to pre-commercial procurement; Germany to High-Tech Strategy and KOINNO, the USA to SBIR and the EU to the Joint Procurement Agreement.

ca885116e63863.s: Who is associated with the concept of mission-oriented procurement?
ca885116e63863.x: Mission-oriented procurement is associated with Mariana Mazzucato.

ca58d9ff419db3.s: Under the present WHO norm, cited in the proposal to make cancer notifiable, which diseases are notifiable?
ca58d9ff419db3.x: At present only communicable diseases are notifiable; the cancer proposal would extend this.

caa048be724f60.s: After the Coldrif cough syrup deaths, the Health Ministry stressed compliance with which requirement?
o: Revised Schedule M on Good Manufacturing Practices
caa048be724f60.x: The Health Ministry stressed strict compliance with revised Schedule M on Good Manufacturing Practices.

caebfc6d22371c.s: Which of the following pairs (year – country of diethylene glycol incident) is correctly matched?
caebfc6d22371c.x: The 2022 incident was in Gambia (over 60 children died) and the 2023 incident in Uzbekistan.

cacd3901ed9851.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the draft amendments to the New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019?
o: They are expected to cut test licence applications by about 25%.
The draft was published in the Gazette on 28 August 2025.
Processing time for test licences falls from 90 days to 45 days.
Low-risk BA/BE studies can start on intimation.
cacd3901ed9851.x: The expected cut in test licence applications is about 50%, not 25%.

cab6a18cf5d6ee.s: According to UNICEF India, non-communicable diseases cause what share of deaths in India?
cab6a18cf5d6ee.x: NCDs cause 63% of deaths in India; 25–26% refers to premature NCD deaths.

ca82649cab45f1.s: The proposal to declare cancer a notifiable disease was linked with which programme and SDG?
ca82649cab45f1.x: The linked programme is NPCDCS and the goal is SDG 3.

cadf9ab09b411b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the human H5N1 death in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The child died on 16 March at AIIMS-Mangalagiri.
The child's contacts tested positive for H5N1.
Infection was confirmed on 31 March by NIV, Pune.
cadf9ab09b411b.x: The child's contacts tested negative for H5N1.

ca5ee3f11d5317.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. NCRB stands for National Crime Records Bureau.
2. Abortions in India are governed by Article 21.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca5ee3f11d5317.x: Statement 1 is correct; abortions are governed by the MTP Act.

cae3be7d7e97d2.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about fertilisers in India?
o: 20:20:0:13 production reached a record 69.7 lakh tonnes in 2024–25.
20:20:0:13 is the second-largest fertiliser after urea.
Ammonium sulphate contains 20.5% nitrogen and 23% sulphur.
The Kharif 2025 shortage was linked to higher acreage with lower production and imports.
cae3be7d7e97d2.x: 20:20:0:13 is the third-largest fertiliser, after urea and DAP.

ca12e6eb5fa1e5.s:
Consider the following statements about ammonium sulphate:
1. It contains 20.5% nitrogen and 23% sulphur.
2. It was suggested as a urea substitute because it contains 23% nitrogen and 20.5% sulphur.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
ca12e6eb5fa1e5.x: Ammonium sulphate has 20.5% nitrogen and 23% sulphur; statement 2 reverses the figures.

caed82caedefb7.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The DGFT 2024 export plan had a dedicated section for the North-East.
2. The India–Myanmar–Thailand Trilateral Highway has stalled.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
caed82caedefb7.x: The DGFT 2024 export plan had no North-East section; the Trilateral Highway has stalled.

ca40c4356eead3.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about SEBI's proposed governance reforms for Market Infrastructure Institutions?
o: The Commercial Interests and Business Development head is an ED at the MII's discretion.
EDs heading the first two verticals would sit on the Governing Board, with SEBI approval for appointment.
Executive Directors may hold non-executive posts in unlisted government companies or not-for-profits.
The consultation paper was issued on 24 June 2025, with comments till 15 July 2025.
ca40c4356eead3.x: Such outside non-executive posts are permitted for Managing Directors; Executive Directors may hold none except in MII subsidiaries.

ca3a7f5047ce6f.s: Which constitutional provision was invoked in Manipur amid the Meitei–Zo crisis?
ca3a7f5047ce6f.x: President's Rule under Article 356 was imposed in Manipur.
